title: Raiden Warned About AI Censorship - MGS2 Codec Call (2023 Version)
summary: A fan-made Metal Gear Solid 2 codec call using AI voice synthesis, in which the Colonel warns Raiden about using AI to censor the internet and enforce digital ID. It riffs on the game's 'Selection for Societal Sanity' conversation.
why: HN users post it as a meme or satirical comment in threads about AI regulation, age verification and online identity.
